content: Both Skip-gram (SG) and fastText (FT) are trained using the reference implementation of fastText with the hyper-parameters given by BIBREF6 ( $\textnormal {window} = 5$ , $\textnormal {initial learning rate} = .025$ , $\textnormal {subsampling} = 10^{-4}$ , $\textnormal {negative samples} = 5$ ).
